params.body:
The three screens #798 deliberately left alone, now that Shane confirmed the surface: show the copy in progress on the dealer's own editing tab, not when someone views the vehicle.

- `website/_wcard.blade.php` — the card on a dealer's own website, which also carries shared vehicles of colleagues
- `ownstock/showroom_vehicle.blade.php` — the showroom slides
- `export/print/print_partials/photos.blade.php` — the print sheet of a bidding vehicle

Their eager loads follow, so the ready relation is preloaded rather than lazily fetched per vehicle.

## The list is now a test

`AnUnfinishedCopyIsNotShownTest` reads all nine screens that show a copy to someone other than the owner and fails on a plain `stocklist_photo` or `primary_stocklist_photo`. Writing it immediately found three reads I had missed in the two files I was editing: the card's carousel set and two lines in the print sheet. That is exactly why the list belongs in a test rather than in a message: the next screen that reads the plain relation has to be a decision, not an oversight.

The owner's own screens and the bookkeeping are untouched and stay out of the list.

## And a decision written down

Shane, on the files of deleted vehicles: "die foto's van verwijderde wagens houden we".

So R S1-6.40 records the split as it stands: deleting a **vehicle** soft-deletes its photo rows and keeps the files in the bucket (the deletion is commented out in `VehicleObserver::deleted`), while deleting a single **photo** does remove the original, the processed version, the thumbnails and the derived sizes. The consequences are named rather than implied: that storage is paid for, and a photo of a deleted vehicle stays retrievable to whoever knows the path, though the URLs are signed so nothing can be browsed.

## Verified

Full suite: 2.133 tests, with only the two known `ListPageHeadersTest` cases failing, which fail the same way without this change because those tables are empty in my local database. `phpstan` green over the whole project; `pint` green.
params.title: The last three screens of another ask for the ready set
